title: Wall Street Journal: Your Mouth Could Hold the Secrets to a Longer and Healthier Life
html:
“Dr. Ana Becil Giglio, a New York periodontist and president of the American Academy of Periodontology, says some of the most promising future treatments for gum disease are aimed at controlling the body’s inflammatory response rather than simply removing plaque or killing bacteria.”

 

Read the full article here.

 

About the American Academy of Periodontology
The American Academy of Periodontology (AAP) represents nearly 7,500 periodontists globally – specialists in the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of inflammatory diseases affecting the gums and supporting structures of the teeth, and in the placement of dental implants. Periodontics is one of 12 dental specialties recognized by the American Dental Association.
